Ferramenta

Gerador iptables (stateful)

Escolhe o caso. Cada modo abre com uma configuração default que já funciona: marca ou desmarca o que o enunciado pede e o resultado atualiza à direita. Em 1 comando respondes a perguntas e sai uma única regra, explicada pedaço a pedaço, com o que mais é preciso para funcionar. O que mudas fica guardado neste browser; Repor default volta ao início.

cliente.sh
Índice dos scripts

Prontos a usar

Scripts prontos

Primeiro os modelos dos 3 casos (o que o Gerador dá por omissão; usam as mesmas regras do firewall-stateful.sh e do gateway-nat.sh). Depois os scripts das aulas, corridos sem erros em Ubuntu 26.04 LTS (iptables 1.8.11 nf_tables; o squid.conf em Squid 7.7), que também estão na pasta GUIA-SS/scripts/. Antes de usar: confirma placas e IPs (ip -br a), chmod +x script.sh e sudo ./script.sh.

Caso 1 · Cliente

cliente.sh

A máquina só usa serviços: DNS, HTTP, HTTPS, SSH, ping e DHCP, tudo na OUTPUT. Não aceita ligações de fora. Explicação: Cliente · para mudar: Gerador, modo Cliente.

#!/bin/bash
# =====================================================================
#  cliente.sh - firewall STATEFUL de um CLIENTE (posto de trabalho)
#  Esta máquina só usa serviços: as regras novas ficam na OUTPUT.
#  Da rede só entram respostas (regra genérica da INPUT).
#  Usar:  chmod +x cliente.sh  &&  sudo ./cliente.sh
# =====================================================================

IPT=/sbin/iptables        # caminho absoluto (evita ataques à PATH)
DYN=1024:65535            # portos dinâmicos (porto de origem do cliente)

#####################################################################
# 1) INICIALIZAÇÃO
#####################################################################
echo "Política por omissão = DROP (o que não é permitido é proibido)"
$IPT -P INPUT   DROP
$IPT -P OUTPUT  DROP
$IPT -P FORWARD DROP

echo "Apagar regras (-F) e chains personalizadas (-X)"
$IPT -F
$IPT -X

#####################################################################
# 2) REGRAS STATELESS
#####################################################################
echo "Loopback (a máquina fala consigo própria, ex.: DNS em 127.0.0.53)"
$IPT -A INPUT  -i lo -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT -o lo -j ACCEPT

#####################################################################
# 3) REGRAS GENÉRICAS STATEFUL
#####################################################################
echo "Aceitar o resto das ligações já autorizadas (respostas)"
$IPT -A INPUT  -m state --state ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT -m state --state ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT

echo "Registar e descartar pacotes inválidos"
$IPT -A INPUT -m state --state INVALID -j LOG --log-prefix "INVALIDO: "
$IPT -A INPUT -m state --state INVALID -j DROP

#####################################################################
# 4) REGRAS STATEFUL ADICIONAIS (só o 1.º pacote: NEW)
#####################################################################
# ----- CLIENTE: esta máquina inicia -> OUTPUT, --dport = porto do serviço remoto
echo "DNS (cliente)"
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p udp --sport $DYN --dport 53 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p tcp --sport $DYN --dport 53 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

echo "HTTP (cliente)"
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p tcp --sport $DYN --dport 80 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

echo "HTTPS (cliente)"
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p tcp --sport $DYN --dport 443 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

echo "SSH (cliente)"
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p tcp --sport $DYN --dport 22 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

echo "Ping (cliente)"
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p icmp --icmp-type echo-request -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

echo "DHCP (cliente): bootpc 68 -> bootps 67"
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p udp --sport 68 --dport 67 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

#####################################################################
echo "Firewall ON"
$IPT -L -n -v --line-numbers

Caso 2 · Servidor

servidor.sh

Aceita SSH, HTTP, HTTPS e ping (INPUT) e usa DNS, HTTP, HTTPS e ping como cliente (OUTPUT). Explicação: Servidor · para mudar: Gerador, modo Servidor.

#!/bin/bash
# =====================================================================
#  servidor.sh - firewall STATEFUL de um SERVIDOR
#  Os outros ligam-se a esta máquina: regras novas na INPUT.
#  Também usa alguns serviços como cliente: regras na OUTPUT.
#  Usar:  chmod +x servidor.sh  &&  sudo ./servidor.sh
# =====================================================================

IPT=/sbin/iptables        # caminho absoluto (evita ataques à PATH)
DYN=1024:65535            # portos dinâmicos (porto de origem do cliente)

#####################################################################
# 1) INICIALIZAÇÃO
#####################################################################
echo "Política por omissão = DROP (o que não é permitido é proibido)"
$IPT -P INPUT   DROP
$IPT -P OUTPUT  DROP
$IPT -P FORWARD DROP

echo "Apagar regras (-F) e chains personalizadas (-X)"
$IPT -F
$IPT -X

#####################################################################
# 2) REGRAS STATELESS
#####################################################################
echo "Loopback (a máquina fala consigo própria, ex.: DNS em 127.0.0.53)"
$IPT -A INPUT  -i lo -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT -o lo -j ACCEPT

#####################################################################
# 3) REGRAS GENÉRICAS STATEFUL
#####################################################################
echo "Aceitar o resto das ligações já autorizadas (respostas)"
$IPT -A INPUT  -m state --state ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT -m state --state ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT

echo "Registar e descartar pacotes inválidos"
$IPT -A INPUT -m state --state INVALID -j LOG --log-prefix "INVALIDO: "
$IPT -A INPUT -m state --state INVALID -j DROP

#####################################################################
# 4) REGRAS STATEFUL ADICIONAIS (só o 1.º pacote: NEW)
#####################################################################
# ----- SERVIDOR: os outros ligam-se a mim -> INPUT, --dport = porto do MEU serviço
echo "SSH (servidor)"
$IPT -A INPUT -p tcp --sport $DYN --dport 22 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

echo "HTTP (servidor)"
$IPT -A INPUT -p tcp --sport $DYN --dport 80 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

echo "HTTPS (servidor)"
$IPT -A INPUT -p tcp --sport $DYN --dport 443 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

echo "Responder a ping (servidor)"
$IPT -A INPUT -p icmp --icmp-type echo-request -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

# ----- CLIENTE: esta máquina também usa serviços -> OUTPUT
echo "DNS (cliente)"
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p udp --sport $DYN --dport 53 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p tcp --sport $DYN --dport 53 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

echo "HTTP (cliente)"
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p tcp --sport $DYN --dport 80 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

echo "HTTPS (cliente)"
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p tcp --sport $DYN --dport 443 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

echo "Ping (cliente)"
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p icmp --icmp-type echo-request -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

#####################################################################
echo "Firewall ON"
$IPT -L -n -v --line-numbers

Caso 3 · Router

router.sh

GATEWAY com 2 placas: ip_forward, MASQUERADE e FORWARD stateful (a LAN usa DNS, HTTP, HTTPS e ping); o router aceita SSH e ping vindos da LAN. Com DNAT: gateway-nat.sh. Explicação: Router · para mudar: Gerador, modo Router.

#!/bin/bash
# =====================================================================
#  router.sh - firewall STATEFUL de um ROUTER / GATEWAY com NAT
#  LAN (enp0s8) ---> ROUTER ---> WAN (enp0s3)
#  ip_forward + FORWARD stateful + NAT à saída da WAN.
#  Usar:  chmod +x router.sh  &&  sudo ./router.sh
# =====================================================================

IPT=/sbin/iptables        # caminho absoluto (evita ataques à PATH)
DYN=1024:65535            # portos dinâmicos (porto de origem do cliente)
WAN=enp0s3                # placa do lado de fora (ver com: ip -br a)
LAN=enp0s8                # placa do lado de dentro
REDE_LAN=192.168.56.0/24  # rede interna

echo "Ativar o encaminhamento de pacotes entre as placas (router)"
sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1

#####################################################################
# 1) INICIALIZAÇÃO
#####################################################################
echo "Política por omissão = DROP (o que não é permitido é proibido)"
$IPT -P INPUT   DROP
$IPT -P OUTPUT  DROP
$IPT -P FORWARD DROP

echo "Apagar regras (-F) e chains personalizadas (-X), também na tabela nat"
$IPT -F
$IPT -X
$IPT -t nat -F
$IPT -t nat -X

#####################################################################
# 2) REGRAS STATELESS
#####################################################################
echo "Loopback (a máquina fala consigo própria, ex.: DNS em 127.0.0.53)"
$IPT -A INPUT  -i lo -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT -o lo -j ACCEPT

#####################################################################
# 3) REGRAS GENÉRICAS STATEFUL
#####################################################################
echo "Aceitar o resto das ligações já autorizadas (respostas)"
$IPT -A INPUT   -m state --state ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT  -m state --state ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A FORWARD -m state --state ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT

echo "Registar e descartar pacotes inválidos"
$IPT -A INPUT -m state --state INVALID -j LOG --log-prefix "INVALIDO: "
$IPT -A INPUT -m state --state INVALID -j DROP
$IPT -A FORWARD -m state --state INVALID -j DROP

#####################################################################
# 4) O PRÓPRIO ROUTER (INPUT e OUTPUT)
#####################################################################
# ----- usa serviços como CLIENTE (ex.: apt update) -> OUTPUT
echo "DNS (router como cliente)"
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p udp --sport $DYN --dport 53 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p tcp --sport $DYN --dport 53 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

echo "HTTP (router como cliente)"
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p tcp --sport $DYN --dport 80 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

echo "HTTPS (router como cliente)"
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p tcp --sport $DYN --dport 443 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

echo "Ping (router como cliente)"
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p icmp --icmp-type echo-request -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

# ----- aceita ligações vindas da LAN -> INPUT -i $LAN
echo "SSH (vindo da LAN)"
$IPT -A INPUT -i $LAN -p tcp --sport $DYN --dport 22 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

echo "Responder a ping (vindo da LAN)"
$IPT -A INPUT -i $LAN -p icmp --icmp-type echo-request -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

#####################################################################
# 5) LAN -> WAN: NAT + FORWARD
#####################################################################
echo "NAT à saída da WAN: a LAN sai com o IP do router (MASQUERADE, IP da WAN por DHCP)"
$IPT -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o $WAN -s $REDE_LAN -j MASQUERADE

# ----- FORWARD: o sentido diz-se com as placas (-i entra, -o sai); --dport = porto do serviço
echo "DNS (LAN -> WAN)"
$IPT -A FORWARD -i $LAN -o $WAN -p udp --dport 53 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A FORWARD -i $LAN -o $WAN -p tcp --dport 53 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

echo "HTTP (LAN -> WAN)"
$IPT -A FORWARD -i $LAN -o $WAN -p tcp --dport 80 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

echo "HTTPS (LAN -> WAN)"
$IPT -A FORWARD -i $LAN -o $WAN -p tcp --dport 443 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

echo "Ping (LAN -> WAN)"
$IPT -A FORWARD -i $LAN -o $WAN -p icmp --icmp-type echo-request -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

#####################################################################
echo "Router ON"
$IPT -L -n -v --line-numbers
$IPT -t nat -L -n -v --line-numbers

Modelo das aulas (cliente + servidor)

firewall-stateful.sh

Modelo stateful com a estrutura das aulas: DNS, HTTP, HTTPS, SSH, ping e DHCP como cliente; SSH e ping como servidor; secção opcional com Apache só para um IP, REJECT do DNS, FTP e limite de ligações TCP.

#!/bin/bash
# =====================================================================
#  firewall-stateful.sh  -  modelo de firewall STATEFUL (iptables)
#  Usar:  chmod +x firewall-stateful.sh   &&   sudo ./firewall-stateful.sh
#
#  Regra de ouro: só se permite o 1.º pacote de cada ligação (NEW).
#  As respostas passam pelas regras genéricas ESTABLISHED,RELATED.
#    - sou CLIENTE  (eu inicio)    -> OUTPUT + --dport <porto do serviço>
#    - sou SERVIDOR (eles iniciam) -> INPUT  + --dport <porto do meu serviço>
# =====================================================================

# caminho absoluto (evita ataques à PATH)
IPT=/sbin/iptables

# portos dinâmicos = porto de origem usado pelo lado cliente
DYN=1024:65535

#####################################################################
# 1) INICIALIZAÇÃO
#####################################################################
echo "Política por omissão = DROP (o que não é permitido é proibido)"
$IPT -P INPUT   DROP
$IPT -P OUTPUT  DROP
$IPT -P FORWARD DROP

echo "Apagar regras (-F) e chains personalizadas (-X)"
$IPT -F
$IPT -X

#####################################################################
# 2) REGRAS STATELESS
#####################################################################
echo "Permitir a interface loopback"
$IPT -A INPUT  -i lo -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT -o lo -j ACCEPT

#####################################################################
# 3) REGRAS GENÉRICAS STATEFUL
#####################################################################
echo "Aceitar pacotes de ligações já estabelecidas ou relacionadas"
$IPT -A INPUT  -m state --state ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT -m state --state ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT

echo "Registar (LOG) e descartar pacotes inválidos"
$IPT -A INPUT -m state --state INVALID -j LOG --log-prefix "INVALIDO: "
$IPT -A INPUT -m state --state INVALID -j DROP

#####################################################################
# 4) REGRAS STATEFUL ADICIONAIS  (só o 1.º pacote: --state NEW)
#####################################################################

# ----- como CLIENTE (a minha máquina inicia a ligação) --------------
echo "DNS (cliente)"
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p udp --sport $DYN --dport 53 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p tcp --sport $DYN --dport 53 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

echo "HTTP e HTTPS (cliente)"
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p tcp --sport $DYN --dport 80  -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p tcp --sport $DYN --dport 443 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

echo "SSH (cliente)"
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p tcp --sport $DYN --dport 22 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

echo "Ping (cliente)"
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p icmp --icmp-type echo-request -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

echo "DHCP (cliente)   bootpc=68 -> bootps=67"
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p udp --sport 68 --dport 67 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

# ----- como SERVIDOR (os outros iniciam a ligação) ------------------
echo "SSH (servidor)"
$IPT -A INPUT -p tcp --sport $DYN --dport 22 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

echo "Responder a ping (servidor)"
$IPT -A INPUT -p icmp --icmp-type echo-request -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

#####################################################################
# 5) OPCIONAL - descomentar o que o enunciado pedir
#####################################################################
# --- servidor web (Apache) só para um IP (ex.: máquina Windows)
# WIN=192.168.56.1
# $IPT -A INPUT -p tcp --sport $DYN --dport 80 -s $WIN -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

# --- rejeitar pedidos DNS recebidos (não sou servidor DNS)
# $IPT -A INPUT -p udp --dport 53 -m state --state NEW -j REJECT
# $IPT -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 53 -m state --state NEW -j REJECT --reject-with tcp-reset

# --- FTP (cliente): módulo que percebe a 2.ª ligação (dados) -> RELATED
# /sbin/modprobe nf_conntrack_ftp
# $IPT -t raw -A OUTPUT -p tcp --dport 21 -j CT --helper ftp   # kernel recente
# $IPT -A OUTPUT -p tcp --sport $DYN --dport 21 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

# --- limitar novas ligações TCP recebidas a 5 por segundo (chain)
#     (tem de ficar ANTES das regras ACCEPT de servidor)
# $IPT -N LIMITATCP
# $IPT -A LIMITATCP -m limit --limit 5/second -j RETURN
# $IPT -A LIMITATCP -j DROP
# $IPT -I INPUT 5 -p tcp -m state --state NEW -j LIMITATCP

#####################################################################
echo "Firewall ON"
$IPT -L -n -v --line-numbers

Desligar

firewall-off.sh

Política ACCEPT e limpeza de regras e chains em todas as tabelas (filter, nat, mangle, raw).

#!/bin/bash
# =====================================================================
#  firewall-off.sh  -  desliga a firewall
#  Política ACCEPT + apaga regras e chains de TODAS as tabelas.
#  Usar:  sudo ./firewall-off.sh
# =====================================================================
IPT=/sbin/iptables

echo "Política por omissão = ACCEPT"
$IPT -P INPUT   ACCEPT
$IPT -P OUTPUT  ACCEPT
$IPT -P FORWARD ACCEPT

echo "Apagar regras e chains personalizadas (filter, nat, mangle, raw)"
for TABELA in filter nat mangle raw; do
    $IPT -t $TABELA -F
    $IPT -t $TABELA -X
done

echo "Firewall OFF"
$IPT -L -n

Limites

limit-ping.sh

Só deixa sair 1 ping a cada 10 segundos (testado: 6 pings → 1 resposta).

#!/bin/bash
# =====================================================================
#  limit-ping.sh  -  esta máquina só consegue ENVIAR 1 ping a cada 10 s
#  6/minuto = 1 a cada 10 segundos;  --limit-burst 1 = sem "rajada" inicial
#  O que passa do limite é descartado: esses pings ficam sem resposta
#  (algumas versões do ping mostram "sendmsg: Operation not permitted")
#
#  IMPORTANTE: estas regras ficam ANTES das genéricas ESTABLISHED,RELATED.
#  Com conntrack, do 2.º ping em diante (mesmo comando ping) os pedidos
#  já são ESTABLISHED e passavam pela regra genérica sem limite.
# =====================================================================
IPT=/sbin/iptables

$IPT -P INPUT   DROP
$IPT -P OUTPUT  DROP
$IPT -P FORWARD DROP
$IPT -F
$IPT -X

# ----- stateless
$IPT -A INPUT  -i lo -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT -o lo -j ACCEPT

echo "Ping de saída limitado a 1 a cada 10 s"
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p icmp --icmp-type echo-request -m limit --limit 6/minute --limit-burst 1 -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p icmp --icmp-type echo-request -j DROP

# ----- genéricas stateful (o echo-reply volta como ESTABLISHED)
$IPT -A INPUT  -m state --state ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT -m state --state ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT

$IPT -L -n -v --line-numbers

Limites

limit-ping-inverso.sh

Ao contrário: nega 1 ping a cada 10 segundos e deixa passar os outros (testado: 6 pings → 5 respostas).

#!/bin/bash
# =====================================================================
#  limit-ping-inverso.sh  -  ao contrário: a firewall NEGA 1 ping a cada
#  10 s e deixa passar os restantes.
#  O limit "apanha" 1 pacote a cada 10 s -> esse vai para DROP.
# =====================================================================
IPT=/sbin/iptables

$IPT -P INPUT   DROP
$IPT -P OUTPUT  DROP
$IPT -P FORWARD DROP
$IPT -F
$IPT -X

# ----- stateless
$IPT -A INPUT  -i lo -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT -o lo -j ACCEPT

echo "Negar 1 ping a cada 10 s; os outros passam"
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p icmp --icmp-type echo-request -m limit --limit 6/minute --limit-burst 1 -j DROP
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p icmp --icmp-type echo-request -j ACCEPT

# ----- genéricas stateful
$IPT -A INPUT  -m state --state ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT -m state --state ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT

$IPT -L -n -v --line-numbers

NAT na própria máquina

redirect-2022.sh

SSH acessível de fora só pelo porto 2022 (testado: 2022 entra, 22 dá timeout).

#!/bin/bash
# =====================================================================
#  redirect-2022.sh  -  SSH acessível de fora só pelo porto 2022
#  2022 -> 22 com REDIRECT (nat) + bloquear o acesso direto ao 22 (raw)
#  Testar de OUTRA máquina:  ssh -p 2022 user@IP   (funciona)
#                            ssh user@IP           (não responde)
# =====================================================================
IPT=/sbin/iptables
DYN=1024:65535

#####################################################################
# 1) INICIALIZAÇÃO (filter + nat + raw)
#####################################################################
$IPT -P INPUT   DROP
$IPT -P OUTPUT  DROP
$IPT -P FORWARD DROP
$IPT -F
$IPT -X
$IPT -t nat -F
$IPT -t raw -F

#####################################################################
# 2) STATELESS + 3) GENÉRICAS STATEFUL
#####################################################################
$IPT -A INPUT  -i lo -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT -o lo -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A INPUT  -m state --state ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT -m state --state ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A INPUT  -m state --state INVALID -j DROP

#####################################################################
# 4) STATEFUL
#####################################################################
echo "SSH (servidor): a filter já vê o porto TRADUZIDO (22)"
$IPT -A INPUT -p tcp --sport $DYN --dport 22 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

echo "Redirecionar 2022 -> 22 (tabela nat, chain PREROUTING)"
$IPT -t nat -A PREROUTING -p tcp --dport 2022 -j REDIRECT --to-ports 22

echo "Negar o 22 a quem vem de fora (tabela raw = antes do NAT)"
$IPT -t raw -A PREROUTING ! -i lo -p tcp --dport 22 -j DROP

# Alternativa sem a tabela raw (aceita só o que ORIGINALMENTE ia para 2022),
# em vez da regra "SSH (servidor)" acima:
# $IPT -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 22 -m conntrack --ctstate NEW --ctorigdstport 2022 -j ACCEPT

$IPT -t nat -L -n -v
$IPT -t raw -L -n -v
$IPT -L -n -v --line-numbers

Bloqueio por lista

facebook-block.sh

Web permitida exceto para as redes do Facebook (lê Facebook-all-ipv4.txt da pasta atual; cria ~360 regras).

#!/bin/bash
# =====================================================================
#  facebook-block.sh  -  web permitida EXCETO para o Facebook (stateful)
#  Precisa do ficheiro com as redes do Facebook (uma por linha), ex.:
#    whois -h whois.radb.net -- '-i origin AS32934' | grep ^route: \
#        | awk '{print $2}' > Facebook-all-ipv4.txt
#  Usar:  sudo ./facebook-block.sh      (demora uns segundos: ~350 regras)
# =====================================================================
IPT=/sbin/iptables
DYN=1024:65535
LISTA=Facebook-all-ipv4.txt

if [ ! -f "$LISTA" ]; then
    echo "Ficheiro $LISTA não encontrado!"
    exit 1
fi

#####################################################################
# 1) INICIALIZAÇÃO + 2) STATELESS + 3) GENÉRICAS STATEFUL
#####################################################################
$IPT -P INPUT   DROP
$IPT -P OUTPUT  DROP
$IPT -P FORWARD DROP
$IPT -F
$IPT -X

$IPT -A INPUT  -i lo -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT -o lo -j ACCEPT

$IPT -A INPUT  -m state --state ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT -m state --state ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A INPUT  -m state --state INVALID -j DROP

#####################################################################
# 4) STATEFUL
#####################################################################
echo "DNS (cliente) - todos os pedidos"
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p udp --sport $DYN --dport 53 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p tcp --sport $DYN --dport 53 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

echo "SSH (cliente e servidor)"
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p tcp --sport $DYN --dport 22 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A INPUT  -p tcp --sport $DYN --dport 22 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

echo "Chain FACEBOOK: rejeita ligações para as redes da lista"
$IPT -N FACEBOOK
while read -r REDE || [ -n "$REDE" ]; do
    [ -z "$REDE" ] && continue
    $IPT -A FACEBOOK -d "$REDE" -j REJECT
done < "$LISTA"
# se o destino não estiver na lista, o pacote chega ao fim da chain
# e volta (RETURN) à OUTPUT, onde é aceite pelas regras seguintes

echo "Web (cliente): primeiro passa pela chain FACEBOOK, depois é aceite"
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p tcp -m multiport --dports 80,443 -m state --state NEW -j FACEBOOK
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p udp --dport 443 -m state --state NEW -j FACEBOOK
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p tcp --sport $DYN -m multiport --dports 80,443 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p udp --sport $DYN --dport 443 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

echo "Regras na chain FACEBOOK: $($IPT -S FACEBOOK | grep -c REJECT)"
$IPT -L OUTPUT -n -v --line-numbers

Router

gateway-nat.sh

VM GATEWAY: encaminhamento, MASQUERADE, FORWARD stateful (LAN só com DNS, HTTP, HTTPS e ping) e DNAT dos portos 80 e 2222 para o servidor interno.

#!/bin/bash
# =====================================================================
#  gateway-nat.sh  -  VM GATEWAY: router com NAT, tudo em modo stateful
#    LAN (host-only) ---> GATEWAY ---> WAN (NAT / Internet)
#  - SNAT (MASQUERADE): a LAN sai para a Internet com o IP do gateway
#  - DNAT: de fora, porto 80 e 2222 do gateway -> servidor interno
#  Usar:  sudo ./gateway-nat.sh
# =====================================================================
IPT=/sbin/iptables
DYN=1024:65535

# ---- AJUSTAR (ver com: ip -br a) -----------------------------------
WAN=enp0s3                 # placa NAT  (lado de fora)
LAN=enp0s8                 # placa host-only (lado de dentro)
REDE_LAN=192.168.56.0/24   # rede interna
SERVIDOR=192.168.56.20     # VM Ubuntu (servidor web + SSH)

echo "Ativar o encaminhamento de pacotes (router)"
sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1

#####################################################################
# 1) INICIALIZAÇÃO (filter + nat)
#####################################################################
$IPT -P INPUT   DROP
$IPT -P OUTPUT  DROP
$IPT -P FORWARD DROP
$IPT -F
$IPT -X
$IPT -t nat -F
$IPT -t nat -X

#####################################################################
# 2) STATELESS
#####################################################################
$IPT -A INPUT  -i lo -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT -o lo -j ACCEPT

#####################################################################
# 3) GENÉRICAS STATEFUL  (também na FORWARD!)
#####################################################################
$IPT -A INPUT   -m state --state ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT  -m state --state ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A FORWARD -m state --state ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A INPUT   -m state --state INVALID -j DROP
$IPT -A FORWARD -m state --state INVALID -j DROP

#####################################################################
# 4) O PRÓPRIO GATEWAY
#####################################################################
echo "Gateway como cliente: DNS, HTTP, HTTPS, ping, DHCP"
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p udp --sport $DYN --dport 53  -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p tcp --sport $DYN --dport 53  -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p tcp --sport $DYN --dport 80  -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p tcp --sport $DYN --dport 443 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p icmp --icmp-type echo-request -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p udp --sport 68 --dport 67 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

echo "Gateway como servidor: SSH e ping só a partir da LAN"
$IPT -A INPUT -i $LAN -p tcp --sport $DYN --dport 22 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A INPUT -i $LAN -p icmp --icmp-type echo-request -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

#####################################################################
# 5) SNAT: LAN -> Internet
#####################################################################
echo "MASQUERADE à saída da placa WAN (IP da WAN obtido por DHCP)"
$IPT -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o $WAN -s $REDE_LAN -j MASQUERADE
# com IP fixo na WAN podia ser:  -j SNAT --to-source <IP_da_WAN>

echo "FORWARD LAN -> WAN: só DNS, HTTP, HTTPS e ping"
$IPT -A FORWARD -i $LAN -o $WAN -p udp --dport 53  -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A FORWARD -i $LAN -o $WAN -p tcp --dport 53  -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A FORWARD -i $LAN -o $WAN -p tcp --dport 80  -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A FORWARD -i $LAN -o $WAN -p tcp --dport 443 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A FORWARD -i $LAN -o $WAN -p icmp --icmp-type echo-request -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

#####################################################################
# 6) DNAT: Internet -> servidor interno
#    Na FORWARD já se vê o destino TRADUZIDO (IP e porto do servidor).
#####################################################################
echo "DNAT: porto 80 do gateway -> $SERVIDOR:80 (web)"
$IPT -t nat -A PREROUTING -i $WAN -p tcp --dport 80 -j DNAT --to-destination $SERVIDOR:80
$IPT -A FORWARD -i $WAN -o $LAN -p tcp -d $SERVIDOR --dport 80 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

echo "DNAT: porto 2222 do gateway -> $SERVIDOR:22 (SSH)"
$IPT -t nat -A PREROUTING -i $WAN -p tcp --dport 2222 -j DNAT --to-destination $SERVIDOR:22
$IPT -A FORWARD -i $WAN -o $LAN -p tcp -d $SERVIDOR --dport 22 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

echo "Gateway ON"
$IPT -L -n -v --line-numbers
$IPT -t nat -L -n -v --line-numbers

Squid

proxy-transparente.sh

GATEWAY com Squid: o HTTP da LAN é desviado para o porto 3129 (intercept); o resto sai com NAT.

#!/bin/bash
# =====================================================================
#  proxy-transparente.sh  -  GATEWAY com Squid em modo transparente
#  HTTP (80) vindo da LAN é desviado para o Squid (porto 3129 intercept).
#  No /etc/squid/squid.conf tem de existir:
#      http_port 3128
#      http_port 3129 intercept
#  Usar:  sudo ./proxy-transparente.sh
# =====================================================================
IPT=/sbin/iptables
DYN=1024:65535

# ---- AJUSTAR (ip -br a) --------------------------------------------
WAN=enp0s3
LAN=enp0s8
REDE_LAN=192.168.56.0/24
SQUID=3129

echo "Ativar o encaminhamento de pacotes"
sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1

# ----- inicialização (filter + nat)
$IPT -P INPUT   DROP
$IPT -P OUTPUT  DROP
$IPT -P FORWARD DROP
$IPT -F
$IPT -X
$IPT -t nat -F
$IPT -t nat -X

# ----- stateless
$IPT -A INPUT  -i lo -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT -o lo -j ACCEPT

# ----- genéricas stateful
$IPT -A INPUT   -m state --state ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT  -m state --state ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A FORWARD -m state --state ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A INPUT   -m state --state INVALID -j DROP

echo "O próprio gateway (o Squid vai à Internet): DNS, HTTP, HTTPS"
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p udp --sport $DYN --dport 53  -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p tcp --sport $DYN --dport 53  -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p tcp --sport $DYN --dport 80  -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A OUTPUT -p tcp --sport $DYN --dport 443 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

echo "Clientes da LAN -> Squid (3128 explícito, $SQUID transparente) e SSH"
$IPT -A INPUT -i $LAN -s $REDE_LAN -p tcp --dport 3128   -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A INPUT -i $LAN -s $REDE_LAN -p tcp --dport $SQUID -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A INPUT -i $LAN -s $REDE_LAN -p tcp --dport 22     -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

echo "Proxy transparente: porto 80 da LAN -> Squid ($SQUID)"
$IPT -t nat -A PREROUTING -i $LAN -p tcp --dport 80 -j REDIRECT --to-ports $SQUID

echo "Resto do tráfego da LAN (DNS, HTTPS, ping) sai com NAT"
$IPT -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o $WAN -s $REDE_LAN -j MASQUERADE
$IPT -A FORWARD -i $LAN -o $WAN -p udp --dport 53  -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A FORWARD -i $LAN -o $WAN -p tcp --dport 53  -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A FORWARD -i $LAN -o $WAN -p tcp --dport 443 -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT
$IPT -A FORWARD -i $LAN -o $WAN -p icmp --icmp-type echo-request -m state --state NEW -j ACCEPT

$IPT -L -n -v --line-numbers
$IPT -t nat -L -n -v --line-numbers

Squid

squid.conf.exemplo

Configuração limpa com todas as regras dos exercícios (passa no squid -k parse; só avisa que ignore-reload viola o HTTP, o que é esperado).

# =====================================================================
#  /etc/squid/squid.conf  -  exemplo limpo com as regras das aulas
#  Antes:  sudo cp /etc/squid/squid.conf /etc/squid/squid.conf.backup
#  Depois: sudo squid -k parse   (verifica)   e   sudo squid -k reconfigure
#  NOTA: all, localhost, manager, to_localhost já existem (não redefinir).
# =====================================================================

# ---------- ACL base
acl localnet src 192.168.56.0/24          # rede dos clientes (AJUSTAR)
acl SSL_ports port 443
acl Safe_ports port 80 21 443 70 210 280 488 591 777 1025-65535
acl CONNECT method CONNECT

# ---------- ACL dos exercícios
acl windows   src 192.168.56.1            # IP da máquina Windows (AJUSTAR)
acl site_hf   dstdomain .httpforever.com
acl aulas     time MTWHF 14:00-18:00      # S M T W H F A = Dom Seg Ter Qua Qui Sex Sáb
acl ipleiria  url_regex -i ipleiria
acl leiria    url_regex -i leiria
acl facebook  dstdomain .facebook.com .fbcdn.net
acl trabalho  time MTWHF 09:00-13:00
acl trabalho  time MTWHF 14:00-18:00      # 2.ª linha com o mesmo nome = OU
acl pdf       urlpath_regex -i \.pdf$

# ---------- REGRAS: lidas de cima para baixo, a 1.ª que bate decide
http_access deny !Safe_ports
http_access deny CONNECT !SSL_ports
http_access allow localhost manager
http_access deny manager

http_access deny site_hf aulas            # nega o site DURANTE as aulas (E)
#http_access deny site_hf !aulas          # (ao contrário: só deixa DURANTE as aulas)
http_access allow ipleiria                # exceção: ...ipleiria... passa
http_access deny leiria                   # nega URLs com "leiria"
http_access deny facebook trabalho        # Facebook negado no horário de trabalho
http_access deny pdf                      # nega .pdf (só funciona em HTTP)

http_access allow windows
http_access allow localnet
http_access allow localhost
http_access deny all                      # no FIM, nega tudo o resto

# ---------- portos
http_port 3128                            # proxy configurado no browser
http_port 3129 intercept                  # proxy transparente (iptables REDIRECT)

# ---------- cache
cache_mem 64 MB
cache_dir ufs /var/spool/squid 1000 16 256    # 1000 MB, 16 pastas, 256 subpastas
refresh_pattern -i \.(png|jpg|gif)$ 120 50% 86400 ignore-reload
refresh_pattern -i \.(css|js)$      120 50% 86400 ignore-reload
refresh_pattern .                     0 20%  4320

# ---------- logs e nome
access_log /var/log/squid/access.log squid
cache_log  /var/log/squid/cache.log
coredump_dir /var/spool/squid
visible_hostname gateway-ss

SSH

sshd_config.exemplo

Excerto com porto 2222, sem root, só chaves e só um utilizador.

# /etc/ssh/sshd_config  -  excerto com as opções pedidas nas aulas
# Testar a sintaxe:   sudo sshd -t
# Ver o que está ativo: sudo sshd -T | grep -Ei 'port|password|permitroot|allowusers'
# Aplicar:            sudo systemctl restart ssh
#   (Ubuntu 24.04+: se o porto não mudar ->
#    sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl restart ssh.socket)

Port 2222                               # porto diferente do 22
PermitRootLogin no                      # root não entra por SSH
PubkeyAuthentication yes                # autenticação por chave pública
PasswordAuthentication no               # sem login por password
AuthorizedKeysFile .ssh/authorized_keys .ssh/authorized_keys2
AllowUsers aluno                        # só este utilizador pode entrar

# Chaves que autenticam o SERVIDOR (fingerprint pedido na 1.ª ligação)
HostKey /etc/ssh/ssh_host_rsa_key
HostKey /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ecdsa_key
HostKey /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key

# ATENÇÃO: os ficheiros em /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/*.conf são lidos
# primeiro e o 1.º valor ganha (ex.: 50-cloud-init.conf com
# "PasswordAuthentication yes"). Confirma sempre com: sudo sshd -T

fail2ban

jail.local

Proteção do SSH contra força bruta (3 tentativas, 10 minutos de bloqueio).

# /etc/fail2ban/jail.local  -  proteger o SSH contra força bruta
# Depois:  sudo systemctl restart fail2ban
#          sudo fail2ban-client status sshd
[sshd]
enabled  = true
port     = 22                 # se o SSH estiver noutro porto, ex.: 2222
filter   = sshd
logpath  = /var/log/auth.log
maxretry = 3                  # n.º de tentativas falhadas antes do ban
findtime = 600                # ... dentro desta janela (segundos)
bantime  = 600                # tempo de bloqueio (segundos)
# Se não existir /var/log/auth.log (sistema só com journald), usar:
# backend = systemd

Hash

brute-hash.py

Força bruta de SHA-256 com prefixo e 4 dígitos (exercício do M6).

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Força bruta: descobre xxxx (0000-9999) tal que SHA256("%&xxxx") == alvo
# Correr:  python3 brute-hash.py
# Outro algoritmo: trocar hashlib.sha256 por hashlib.md5 / sha1 / sha512
import hashlib

alvo = "5c768b72dd12f977360d0124c0adf74c44c809b4aa08de07a3acffbc576b15f4"
prefixo = "%&"

for n in range(10000):
    candidato = f"{prefixo}{n:04d}"          # 7 -> "0007"
    if hashlib.sha256(candidato.encode()).hexdigest() == alvo:
        print("Encontrei:", candidato)
        break
else:
    print("Não encontrado")

Documentação: comandos, opções e diretivas

Tudo o que se usa nas matérias, com o que faz, exemplos e dicas: Linux e redes, nmap, SSH, iptables, Squid, cifra/hash/esteganografia, GnuPG e certificados. Pesquisa por opção exata (-n, -sS, --dport, -P ≠ -p), por ferramenta e opção (nmap -n, gpg --verify), por diretiva (refresh_pattern) ou por palavra (masquerade, salt, túnel). Sem pesquisa, mostra tudo organizado por matéria e ferramenta.

Guia de estudo baseado nos materiais M1–M7 de Segurança de Sistemas (slides, fichas e scripts da pasta do teste). Os scripts das aulas foram testados em Ubuntu 26.04 LTS com iptables 1.8.11 (nf_tables) e Squid 7.7. Funciona sem Internet: abre o ficheiro guia-ss.html no Firefox.
